name: Dance In The Starlight cuts Blanket of Stars' cooldown by 10 seconds (#1026)
contract: Dance In The Starlight 503637 (Spell.dbc, SpellFamilyName 32 (Starcaller). Effect 0 SPELL_AURA_ADD_FLAT_MODIFIER (107), EffectMiscValue 11, EffectBasePoints -10001 with DieSides 1 resolves to -10000 ms, EffectSpellClassMask word2 0x2000000. Blanket of Stars 804381 has SpellFamilyFlags word2 0x2000000, RecoveryTime 35000 and DurationIndex 31 (8000 ms), so the tooltip 'Reduces the cooldown of Blanket of Stars by $/1000;s1 sec.' is a flat spellmod on that spell. Native path: Player::AddSpellAndCategoryCooldowns applies SPELLMOD_COOLDOWN to the recovery time (35 s to 25 s). The spell_modifier metric calls Player::ApplySpellMod for 804381 with base 35000. It proves the modifier the cast would apply without needing a shield or a cast. Both fixtures are the same race, class and level with no ratings or gear, so only the learned passive can move the difference. Nothing in AscensionStarcallerContracts.cpp touches this spell id, and the scenario is a regression guard: it is expected to pass on the shipped data.
